**What you’re asking for** - A place where anyone can upload a photo of their pet. - Other people (logged‑in) can **like** those photos. - No payments, no sensitive data – just pictures and a “like” count. Because people upload and like, we need logins so we can rule who can delete or like their own work, and we need storage rules so users can only change their own files. That puts the app in the **Amber** risk level. --- ## Safety parts I’ll add for you | Feature | Safety part | |---------|-------------| | Photo uploads | • Store in a private Supabase bucket.
• Users can only create, view, delete their own files.
• File‑type and size limits (e.g. jpg/png, <5 MB). | | Likes | • Likes table where each row is `user_id, photo_id`.
• Users can like or unlike only once per photo.
• Rate‑limit likes a user can make per minute. | | Logins | • Email‑only magic‑link login (Supabase Auth).
• Site address and redirect set up in Supabase Auth settings. | | Data encryption | Supabase handles TLS and server‑side encryption; no client‑side secret keys. | | Save point | I’ll commit a Git snapshot before each change. | All of these are standard best‑practice steps for an Amber‑level app. --- ## One‑screen plan (will we need more details?) ``` What we are building: A pet‑photo sharing page with likes. Who uses it: Anyone with an email address. Risk level: Amber (logins, uploads, likes). Day‑one features: 1. Sign‑in page (magic link). 2. Upload a photo (jpg/png <5 MB). 3. Show all photos with like buttons and like counts. Information it stores: photo metadata (URL, user_id, created_at), likes table. Private data: user email only (stored by Supabase Auth). Logins: email‑only magic link (Supabase Auth). Money: none. (Spending caps on Supabase are free at this level.) Built with: Lovable + Supabase (no server code needed). (Supabase provides all the needed services). Steps: 1. Set up Supabase project and auth. 2. Create a private storage bucket, enable RLS and policy for own files. 3. Add a `photos` table (id, url, user_id, created_at). 4. Add a `likes` table (id, user_id, photo_id, created_at). Add policies to allow a user to create/delete a like only once per photo. 5. In Lovable, add a magic‑link sign‑in button and a form to upload a photo (only after sign‑in). 6. Build a gallery component that shows each photo, its like count, and a button to like/unlike (with per‑user logic). Safety: keys stay on the server (Supabase), data locked to owner via RLS, spend caps on Supabase APIs, and a save point before every change. Not in version one: comment sections, profiles, or payments. ``` **Does this look right?** Reply “yes” or tell me what to change, and I’ll create the first save point and start step 1.
